top_news.title: Emerging Currencies Cap Longest Winning Streak Since 2007
top_news.summary: An index for emerging-market currencies rose for a 10th successive week, its longest winning streak since 2007, even as a blowout US jobs report briefly jolted global markets on Friday.

top_news.title: S&P Downgrades Senegal After Government Unveils Debt Rework
top_news.summary: S&P Global Ratings cut Senegal’s credit score further into junk territory, saying a distressed debt exchange or default on the country’s foreign-currency commercial debt is “extremely likely” after the government launched a plan to restructure its obligations.

top_news.title: S&P 500 Ends Week Flat as Strong Jobs Growth Fuels Fed-Hike Bets
top_news.summary: US stocks finished lower on Friday as the American economy ​added more jobs than expected in August, raising expectations that the Federal Reserve may hike interest rates soon.

top_news.title: Hedge Funds Hike Bullish Oil Bets to May High as Iran War Flares
top_news.summary: Hedge funds turned the most bullish on Brent crude since May as a fresh spate of fighting between the US and Iran heightened concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Lutnick to Review Pentagon Deals Involving Cerberus Companies
top_news.summary: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has been chosen by the Department of Defense to review any transactions between the Pentagon and companies associated with Cerberus Capital Management, according to a US official.

top_news.title: Dollar Posts Weekly Loss as Yen Jumps Amid Shifting Rate Bets
top_news.summary: The dollar slid to start September as mixed signals on the Federal Reserve’s next move kept traders on edge ahead of a pivotal inflation report, while a surging yen reverberated across global currency markets.

top_news.title: Algorithm Research CEO on Interest Rates Expectations
top_news.summary: Ketaki Sharma, founder and CEO of Algorithm Research, says the inflation is the main factor to watch in assessing the the bond market and the Federal Reserve’s next move. She speaks on "Horizons: Middle East and Africa." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Stocks Fall as Jobs Fuel Bets Fed Will Raise Rates: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: A stronger-than-anticipated increase in US jobs drove stocks and short-dated notes lower, with traders boosting their bets the Federal Reserve will raise rates this month.

top_news.title: Parents Push Teens to Start Investing Earlier Than They Did
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Josyana Joshua joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." Many parents are opening accounts that let teens learn the basics of investing with their supervision, in hopes of teaching them about investing early. As a result, financial firms have noticed and are rolling out products designed to appeal to parents and teens, such as joint brokerage accounts and parental-managed accounts that invest in exchange-traded funds. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Heinekin Highlights Nonalcoholic Beer, Serena Williams in US Open Partnership
top_news.summary: Maggie Timoney, CEO of Heinekin USA, said Heinekin's 0.0 nonalcoholic beer has seen success because consumers are looking to moderate their alcohol consumption, even if they're not looking to cut it out entirely. Timoney said that the beverage company wanted to honor the history of the US Open and the six championships won by Serena Williams in their partnership with the tennis star.  (Source: Bloomberg)
